paper_title: Dark Matter Direct Detection with Accelerometers
notes: Proposal paper (projections only, no measured limit). Considers three couplings: B-L vector (VectorBL), Higgs-portal scalar (~ScalarNucleon/ScalarBaryon), and scalar coupled to electron mass (ScalarElectron). Main exclusion/sensitivity results are in Figs 2-4 (not machine-readable). Only a rough text-quoted projection is extractable: Lunar Laser Ranging reach g_B-L ~ 5e-26 for m < ~1e-21 eV. Coupling type ambiguous across VectorBL/ScalarBaryon/ScalarElectron, hence low confidence. Local DM density taken as 0.3 GeV/cm^3 as stated in text. | [VISION GATE A] is_projection=true but the vision notes say the traced curve is existing experiment 'staticep' — not the paper's own projected curve
